import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_22/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_22/training_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: School info table
# Index column is the first column (School ID), so ignore it by index_col=0
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Load Source 1: Student scores table
# Index column is the first column (Student ID), so ignore it by index_col=0
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Transformation plan:
# Target schema: ['school_name': string, 'math_score': integer]
# Source 0 has school_name but no math_score.
# Source 1 has school_name and math_score per student.
# Target examples show math_score values are very large numbers (e.g., 190115).
# Source 1 math_score values are per student and much smaller (e.g., 71, 83, 92).
# So likely the target math_score is the sum of math_score per school_name.
# Source 0 can be used to ensure all schools are included (even if no students?),
# but since target examples only show schools with math_score, we can join Source 0 and Source 1 on school_name.
# However, Source 1 already has school_name and math_score, so we can aggregate Source 1 by school_name summing math_score.
# Then, to ensure school_name strings are consistent, we can join with Source 0 on school_name.
# This also ensures we only include schools present in Source 0 (the dimension table).
# Finally, select columns school_name and math_score (sum).

# Aggregate Source 1 math_score by school_name (sum)
df_scores_agg = df_source1.groupby("school_name", as_index=False)["math_score"].sum()

# Join aggregated scores with Source 0 on school_name to ensure consistent school names and filter schools
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source0[["school_name"]], df_scores_agg, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Ensure math_score is integer type as per target schema
df_joined["math_score"] = df_joined["math_score"].astype(int)

# Final target dataframe
df_target = df_joined[["school_name", "math_score"]]

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_22/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

# Join Source1 and Source0 on school_name (inner join)

# Group by school_name and aggregate sum of math_score
